name: Cecil Glover
source:
[i]"If you're really a member of House Yulewood, show me proof!"[/i]

[i]Confident Accuser[/i]

Son of a distinguished noble family. He has a highly strung personality and is often outspoken.

He attends the same university as Liam and considers him a friend. He firmly believes the heroine is a fraud who's pretending to be a member of House Yulewood, and as a result, he's incredibly harsh with her. 

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=cecil]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
